name: valuz-dsh-runtime
description: Valuz deploy root for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) runtime: the upstream dsh distribution as published (@deepseek-ai/dsh — launcher, app-boot, plugin manager, every shipped bundle) plus the Valuz layer as an ordinary dsh bundle (valuz-plugins/valuz-dsh-bundle). Kernel sessions boot the managed profile `valuz` (dsh-base + dsh-web-app + dsh-sdk-app + valuz-dsh-bundle + whatever the user installed the dsh way) in the session role; the desktop's resident manager host boots the same profile in the manager role. Staying current with upstream is one version: bash scripts/dsh-upstream-sync.sh moves the @deepseek-ai/dsh pin and the bundle's peer pin together, refreshes the lockfile and the drift fixtures, then runs the compatibility tests. Only the pins + lockfile are committed; node_modules is fetched at build time (npm ci) and staged into the desktop bundle's libexec, run under Electron-as-node. The desktop's Electron is pinned to the exact version dsh's own desktop locks (apps/desktop in the dsh repo): dsh's native addon node-addon-require-builtin fingerprints the runtime and accepts only the exact Electron releases it was built against.
